verdict.rationale: Notion's marketing gestures at AI capabilities like instant answers with citations and 24/7 agents, which could plausibly support drafting a status update from workspace activity, but no evidence specifically describes generating project/status updates from recent activity. Missing for 10: concrete documentation or feature description of AI drafting status/initiative updates, evidence of it referencing 'recent activity' specifically, and any independent/hands-on confirmation this works as described.
